name: Aizawa
source:
She is a clerk at a convenience store attached to a hospital. In reality, she is an undercover police officer to uncover the connection between the hospital and criminal organizations.

She is a righteous woman with a strong sense of justice and values her friends. She asks Yamada to help her in her undercover work.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
